blind.description: A fortune teller's crystal ball featuring a cloudy, marbled purple-and-white stone or glass sphere resting inside a metallic gold claw/prong holder, mounted onto a circular dark-brown wooden base with a flat bottom. All surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with no floating, broken, or melted parts.
blind.from_above: A circular white-and-lavender marbled sphere with small golden claw tips visible around its perimeter, casting a soft shadow to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/6 to 1/7 the height of the figure (around 9-11 inches tall), and roughly the same in width.
